text: Realizability semantics (Kleene 1945) assigns to each formula φ a set of natural numbers (realizers). A realizer of A→B is:
choices: a Turing machine e such that e(n) realizes B for every n realizing A
the product of realizers of A and B
the minimum of realizers of A
explanation: Kleene realizability: e⊩A→B iff for all n: n⊩A ⟹ {e}(n)↓ and {e}(n)⊩B. It is a number-theoretic semantics that makes constructive logic computationally explicit.
